name: yurievyuri/address-parser
description: Parses free-form postal address strings into structured components: line1, line2, city, postcode, country.

suggest.anthropic-ai/sdk: Needed only for the built-in Claude provider (LLM refinement).
suggest.symfony/yaml: Lets you configure the provider pipeline from a YAML file.
suggest.ext-curl: Needed by the default HTTP transport, used to reach a libpostal service.
